name: omniauth/webauthn
description: Omniauth's WebAuthn over web-auth/webauthn-lib, under any PHP host - passkeys: the sign-in (request options, then the assertion checked: origin, relying party, user verification required, counter and backup flags kept) and the registration (creation options, then the attestation checked), on the credential record as omnibase's userPasskey table holds it - the 13 fields of WebAuthn's CredentialRecord, in their base64 text - so a passkey registered by web-auth/webauthn-symfony-bundle signs in here and one registered here is read by the bundle. A software authenticator (P-256) signs real assertions in tests. Formerly omniauth/passkey, which it replaces (the Omniauth\Passkey\ names stay aliases for one release).
